newsitem.title: TURKEY: Kurd rebels kill 3 soldiers in Turk oil well attack.
newsitem.headline: Kurd rebels kill 3 soldiers in Turk oil well attack.

text.p: Kurdish separatist guerrillas have killed three soldiers and wounded two in an attack on an oil well installation in eastern Turkey, security officials said on Wednesday.
The Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) rebels attacked the oil well, belonging to the state-owned TPAO oil company, on Tuesday night in the eastern province of Batman, an official told Reuters.
The fighting took place as Turkish troops pressed on with a cross-border operation against guerrilla positions in northern Iraq, from where the PKK launches attacks into southeastern Turkey.
More than 24,000 people have died in 12 years of conflict between troops and the PKK, fighting for self rule in the mainly Kurdish southeast.
